rationale: Held text (45 FR 44249) confirms EO 12221's single paragraph amending section 8 of EO 12044 to a 1981-04-30 sunset. Held EO 12291 section 10 (signed 1981-02-17) revokes EO 12044 as amended, with no delayed effect, so the clause ended 1981-02-17, and in any event by 1981-04-30. The number search found no earlier ending in the held texts, and the gaps are honestly stated.
